name: Nesco Fd-77dt 4 Tray Digital Dehydrator
description: NEW! Nesco American Harvest Digital 4 Tray Dehydrator Model FD-77DT The Nesco FD-77DT comes with 4 trays, but is expandable to 12 trays with optional Add-A-Trays «. Trays are 13 1/2" in diameter. Digital Timer is programmable for up to 24 hours of drying time. New-Powerful Top Mounted Fan and 600 watts of drying power generate maximum speed and quality for dehydrating fruits, vegetables, and jerky. Helps dry food in hours, not days like other food dehydrators. The adjustable thermostat allows you to dry different foods at proper temperatures (95-160 F), providing the flexibility to produce the best drying results. Patented Converga-Flow « drying system forces air down the exterior pressurized chamber (not through the trays). The hot air is forced horizontally across each individual tray, converging on the core for fast, even and nutritious drying. No flavor mixing and no need to rotate trays. The Nesco FD-77DT Model Includes: 1 Fruit Roll Sheet 1 Clean-a-Screen 1 Original Jerky Spice flavor and 1 cure pack

name: Weston Products Weston Vegikiln 10 Tray Food Dehydrator
description: The Weston 10-tray food dehydrator easily makes healthy, delicious and natural snacks like banana chips, fruit roll-ups, yogurt and jerky. The Weston 75-0201-W Vegikiln food dehydrator makes great take-along snacks for hunting, fishing camping or road trips. The Weston 10-tray food dehydrator retains natural flavor of foods without additives or preservatives. This 75-0201-W 10 tray dehydrator has an efficient drying system that circulates air through each tray, with no rotation required. Weston/ Pragotrade VegiKiln Dehydrator Features: 10 tray dehydrator Color coded thermostat adjusts 84 to 155 degrees F for custom food drying Dehydrated foods easily release from trays Over 10 square feet of food dehydrator drying space Weston food dehydrator is ultra quiet with a 5.5" fan Each dehydrator drying tray measures 14.25" x 10.75" Rear mounted drying system circulates air from back to front through each tray Tray rotation not necessary with this food dehydrator 600 Watt heating element Food dehydrator is lightweight Convenient counter top design Includes instructions and recipe book Material: Solid ABS thermoplastic Weston provides limited one year warranty Overall dimensions: 15.5" H x 15.2" W x 21" D
